issues.description: The problem statement and the template define Developer.monthsOfSwiftExperience as an Int? (optional Int), but the solution implementation uses Double? for the same property. This cross-artifact type mismatch can confuse students comparing the solution to the specification and may lead to inconsistent implementations (e.g., adding 1 to a Double vs. an Int).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the monthsOfSwiftExperience type consistent across artifacts. Preferably update the solution to use Int? (matching the problem statement and template): change the property and initializer parameter to Int?, adjust arithmetic to use Int (increment by 1), and ensure swiftExperienceDescription() and attend(course:) handle Int values accordingly. Alternatively, if Double is intended, update the problem statement and template to specify Double? instead of Int?.
